prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Sync & Protect Your Pet", "Create or sign into your account so your pet's memory, items, and growth are safely backed up to the cloud.", "Cloud Backup Enabled"]
1: ["Find Your Ideal Companion", "Answer a quick question to help us suggest the perfect desktop pet experience for you.", "What kind of desktop companion do you prefer?"]
2: ["Welcome to Your Desktop Companion", "Discover how your new virtual pet lives right on your desktop, bringing fun interactions and daily company."]
3: ["Upload Clear Photos", "For best custom generation results, upload well-lit, front-facing photos of your pet."]
4: ["Give Your Pet a Name", "Choose a name for your companion to personalize their adoption certificate.", "Pet Name", "Confirm Name"]
5: ["Tip: Well-lit, close-up photos facing forward produce the most accurate 3D pet model."]
6: ["Hatching Your Companion...", "We are creating your pet's 3D model and animations. It will be ready on your desktop in just a moment!"]
7: ["Check Your Desktop", "Your pet should now be sitting near your screen corner or taskbar. Can you see your new friend?", "Yes, I See My Pet!"]
8: ["Your Pet is Live!", "Congratulations! Your desktop companion is adopted and active on your computer screen.", "Setup Completed"]
9: ["Sign In to Continue", "Connect your account to save your companion's certificate and progress."]
